problem_statement: B09j CandidateDecision currently has calculation_result_refs=[]; B07c may emit STATE only when explicit canonical CalculationResult refs are supplied. Agronomy Judge reruns irrigation skills later and therefore its outputs are not automatically the original Candidate calculation basis.

proposed_binding.source_of_calculation_outputs: same immutable decision_recommendation_v1 source fact used by B09j Candidate binding
proposed_binding.canonical_evidence_refs_source: exact B09j/B09h canonical EvidenceQualification ref set
proposed_binding.context_snapshot_ref_source: CandidateDecision.basis.context_snapshot_ref; remains null until separately authorized binding
proposed_binding.crop_stage_state_ref_source: CandidateDecision.basis.crop_stage_state_ref; remains null until separately authorized binding
proposed_binding.decision_time_source: CandidateDecision.decision_time; remains null until B09y semantics are authorized and bound
proposed_binding.evaluated_at_source: immutable recommendation source fact occurred_at for deterministic shadow projection only
proposed_binding.evaluated_at_limitation: source fact persistence time is not canonical decision_time and does not establish original computation-time authority

judge_congruence_rule.purpose: Reuse existing B07c criterion producer without letting a later Judge recomputation rewrite original Candidate basis.
judge_congruence_rule.null_and_numeric_semantics: structural/null exactness plus finite numeric equality after existing route normalization; no omitted-field defaults may be used to claim congruence
judge_congruence_rule.evidence_judge_blocked_behavior: B07c QUALIFIED_EVIDENCE path only; STATE remains unbound

state_criterion_rule.producer: existing B07c Agronomy Judge eligibility precursor only

required_b02_topology_if_later_implement: register B09j shadow runtime as explicit consumer of irrigation-calculation-result-compatibility-adapter
register persisted recommendation skill_trace -> B06b CalculationResult shadow edge
register CalculationResult ref supply into existing B07c precursor only
preserve final DecisionEligibilityDecision producer/runtime as disconnected

authorizes: shadow-only same-source recommendation skill_trace -> B06b CalculationResult binding design/implementation
exact Judge/source-input congruence gate before supplying CalculationResult refs to B07c
B02 topology registration for those shadow edges
does_not_authorize: using later/changed Judge outputs as original Candidate calculation basis
